_note: Reel 6 live footage (v6 kit + patch6v v2, cut.sh v5). Two die-mode takes of daily-tower-web/3d.html (the 3D roguelike) with different seeds, captured frame by frame on a virtual clock. Die mode is a scripted input policy: walk to foes, never attack, alternate waiting (taking a hit) and sidestepping until the hero dies, hold the fail screen 0.3 s (push 5 motion fix, was 0.8 s), retry. Shot windows are rebuilt by live/shots6v.py from the DEATH times and may not start on a static frame; the shots below are placeholders that carry the text. The DEATH n counter numbers the deaths shown in this Reel. Camera orbit/pull-in are recorder-only. Use '4 WAYS TO DIE' only if the log shows 4 distinct killers.
_caption_disclosure: Live capture of AI-written game code, rendered frame by frame on a controlled clock so it plays at game speed. Inputs and the camera are scripted by the recorder, which walks the hero into enemies on purpose.
caption:
This 3D roguelike keeps killing me. I told my bot to walk into the slime, and it listened. 💀

Daily Tower is an early-build 3D roguelike written by AI. Follow to watch it get built.
